queue.brief: When a project derails, the last thing your team wants to do is write up what happened — but skipping the post-mortem means making the same mistakes again. This post shows how to pull every relevant data point from your monday.com board and turn it into a structured post-mortem document automatically.
queue.description: Target keyword: "monday.com post-mortem report."
